name: RC-B10-0419/2025 – After § 4 – Am 5
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on a united response to recent Russian violations of the EU Member States’ airspace and critical infrastructure
part_text: 4b. Deplores the fact that the militaristic and aggressive policy of Ursula von der Leyen and Kaja Kallas has brought the Member States very close to a dramatic conflict with the potential for nuclear escalation; demands an urgent redirection of the Union’s policy towards diplomacy, civilian protection and de-escalation, placing peace, human security and conflict resolution above further military escalation;
